question: Who became the first artist with a learning disability to win the Turner Prize?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nnena Kalu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Nnena Kalu becomes the first artist with a learning disability to win the Turner Prize.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **She is a 59-year-old Scottish artist with autism and limited verbal communication.**
 
• **Received the Turner Prize worth £25,000 in Bradford, northern England.**
 
• **Her win is considered a historic breakthrough for inclusivity in the arts.**
 
• **Challenges long-standing barriers within elite cultural institutions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Turner Prize** – Prestigious annual visual arts award in the United Kingdom.
 
• **Inclusivity in Arts** – Promoting participation and recognition of diverse and marginalized artists.
 
• **Learning Disability** – Neurological condition affecting learning, including autism in this case.
 
• **Bradford, England** – Location where the award ceremony took place.
